summary: Completed comprehensive testing of QR Code features for Quick Wing Fleet Management. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend QR code features verified working: QR Scanner modal, Vehicle QR Code modal with Download/Print buttons, vehicle cards displaying mileage/location/last updated by info.

Backend: Admin login successful
Backend: Staff login successful
Backend: GET /api/vehicles/{id} returns vehicle details for QR display

Backend: POST /api/vehicles/{id}/scan-update - status 'In Use' works
Backend: POST /api/vehicles/{id}/scan-update - status 'Needs Cleaning' works
Backend: POST /api/vehicles/{id}/scan-update - status 'Needs Repair' works
Backend: GET /api/vehicles/{id}/status-history returns history entries

Backend: scan-update requires authentication (401/403)
Backend: status-history requires authentication (401/403)
Backend: Vehicle response includes all QR-related fields (id, name, registration, current_status, current_mileage, location, last_updated_by)
Backend: Vehicle reset to 'Free' status successful
Frontend: Scan QR button visible on Live Fleet page
Frontend: QR Scanner modal opens with camera permission request
Frontend: Vehicle QR Code modal opens when clicking QR icon on vehicle card
Frontend: QR Code modal shows Download button

Mileage is validated as integer in backend
Status updates are logged to status_updates collection with source='qr_scan'
Vehicle cards correctly display current_mileage, location, and last_updated_by fields
QR Code modal has both Download (PNG) and Print functionality
QR Scanner uses html5-qrcode library with camera permission handling

context_for_next_testing_agent: QR Code features fully tested and working: 1) POST /api/vehicles/{id}/scan-update endpoint updates vehicle status (Free/In Use/Needs Cleaning/Needs Repair), mileage, location, and logs to status_updates collection. 2) GET /api/vehicles/{id}/status-history returns update history. 3) Frontend QR Scanner modal opens from 'Scan QR' button on Live Fleet page. 4) Vehicle QR Code modal shows QR code with Download/Print buttons. 5) Vehicle cards display mileage, location, and 'last updated by' info.
